source.title: Colorado River Accounting and Water Use Report: Arizona, California, and Nevada, Calendar Year 2025
source.publisher: U.S. Bureau of Reclamation, Interior Region 8 Lower Colorado Basin
source.definition: Consumptive use = diversions from the mainstream less measured and unmeasured return flows (report glossary p2). Mainstream Colorado River only; not tributaries (e.g. Gila, Salt), groundwater or other supplies.

threshold: Users with at least 10,000 acre-ft consumptive use; 91 smaller listed users omitted from circles
